video.decoding_capability: AI Off: 2CH at 32MP, 4CH at 16MP, 8CH at 8MP, 16CH at 4MP (30 fps); AI On: 1CH at 32MP, 2CH at 16MP, 4CH at 8MP, 12CH at 4MP (30 fps)

features: Power consumption stated as < 10 W (HDD not included)
PoE: 130 W (max. output for single port: 25.5 W)
Bandwidth stated as AI Off 400 Mbps incoming/outgoing; AI On 220 Mbps incoming/outgoing
Analytics by Recorder: iMD NVR 8CH, VCA NVR 4CH (10 rules per channel), Face Capture and Recognition 2CH
Analytics by Camera: iMD 16CH, VCA 16CH, Face Picture Comparison Alarm 16CH, LumiSearch+ 16CH (LumiSearch+-enabled camera required), Video Metadata 8CH
License Plate Recognition 8CH (LPR camera required), 2 block lists, 2 allow lists, up to 20,000 plates
Up to 20 face picture libraries (max. 20,000 pictures)
LumiPower long-distance PoE support on ports 1-8
Clients: LumiViewer, LumiViewer Mobile App, LumiCloud
